title: Kenyan Ugali with Steamed Vegetables
description: A traditional Kenyan meal made with cornmeal and served with steamed vegetables. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot.
Gradually add the cornmeal, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Reduce heat to medium and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring frequently.
While the ugali is cooking, steam the carrots, zucchini, and onions until tender.
Heat a tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the steamed vegetables to the pan and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the steamed vegetables alongside the ugali.
